SELECT 
    vendregistry,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (vendrate * 10) + 
        (CAST(vendsucccount AS numeric) / CAST(vendtxcount AS numeric)) * 50 + 
        (CASE vendchecklvl WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Advanced' THEN 2 WHEN 'Premium' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) * 15 - 
        (CAST(venddisputecount AS numeric) / CAST(vendtxcount AS numeric)) * 100 
    AS numeric), 2) AS vendor_relationship_strength
FROM vendors
WHERE vendtxcount >= 1
ORDER BY vendor_relationship_strength;
